column12: A rare splash of color here.
A gnarled tree clinging to life.
The ground here is uneven and cracked.
Its chime has faded to silence.
Whose face did it once hide?
Faint images of a distant past.
Little more than twigs and dust.
What secrets lie within the shards?
Reflects more than the eye can see.
Crack the ice to see beneath.
A dark space under old roots.
Rumored to be full of mischief.
Dark herbs hang from the rafters.
Massive stones tell of battles past.
Voices of soldiers lost to time.
Pale light washes over ancient stones.
Ashes swirl in the faint glow.
The wind howls with forgotten rage.
Your reflection is not your own.
A darkness clings to every step.
Your bones ache with ancient hunger.
Your resolve flickers like dying light.
You see only the flaws in your soul.
Earth clings to your very being.
The ground gives way beneath you.
A spider's sting in the dark.
Ancient jaws close on the careless.
Cold seeps deep into the bones.
The blade still drips with blood.
